meaning: A batch is 5 PRs merged together as one tranche (issue #4). Jev determines the composition: same_change groups are atomic and combine into ONE pull request inside their batch. Batches are disjoint: every PR belongs to at most one batch. Ordered security-first. Model-suggested, not verified safe to merge.
